🐦 My Face Flappy Game

🎵 Your uploaded flying song and game-over audio are already built into this game. No need to upload them again.

Add your songs, then tap Start Game.

How to play: tap the game or FLAP button, press Space, or say “FLAP” if your browser supports voice recognition. On Android, allow microphone permission when prompted. Audio starts after you press Start because browsers require a user gesture.
